messages:
Sara: incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired: PD-84921 - runtime-serve-us-east-1 p99 latency > 1.2s (auto-trigger). https://pagerduty.example/PD-84921 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Alert details: metric=runtime.p99 latency, window=60s, value=1.38s, threshold=1.2s. Top hosts: rtm-03, rtm-07
Matt: acked PD-84921 — I'm looking. anyone else seeing traffic spike?
Alex: I have a runbook up. will check KV cache warmup and gpu pool. pulling logs now.
Jun: got a brief spike in prefix cache misses + GC logs at ~2115009800, might correlate.
Sara: also seeing increased 5xx rate from edge LB for same time window, but only ~0.2% overall.
Matt: pagerduty-bot: PD-84921 escalated to SRE after 2m no ack? (automated escalation)
Matt: I already acked, looks like PD escalation lagged. :grimacing:
Alex: grep of runtime logs shows repeated "kv_miss_prefetch" followed by delayed kv_warmup for rtm-07. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T18:37:12Z rtm-07 kv_miss_prefetch key=abcd... latency_ms=12
2026-03-14T18:37:13Z rtm-07 kv_warmup start
2026-03-14T18:37:14Z rtm-07 kv_warmup complete duration_ms=1450
```
Jun: that 1.45s warmup could push p99 over threshold if several tokens line up. looks noisy though — not sustained.
Sara: incident-bot: PD-84921 auto-resolved by PagerDuty (no active alerts) :white_check_mark:
Matt: it resolved quickly, but then I see a re-fire: incident-bot: PagerDuty fired PD-84922 (same symptom)
pagerduty-bot: PD-84922 triggered at 2115009940
Alex: ugh a loop — probably the threshold and short-lived kv warmups causing multiple pages. I'll add a short suppression rule on the alert for 3m and escalate if sustained 10m.
Jun: +1 for temporary suppression. otherwise we'll get pager fatigue.
Matt: created a 3m silence in PagerDuty for the alerting rule ID alert::runtime_p99_us_east. note in PD: "temp silence during investigation"
Sara: doing a quick customer-impact check: internal traces show increased latency to customers on a small fraction of requests (~0.15% of requests in the window) — no client-visible errors reported.
Alex: rolled a quick config to warm KV proactively on cold starts for rtm-07 and rtm-03 (patch applied). monitoring.
Jun: I'm watching metrics — p99 dropped back to 0.9s after warmup patch, small blips remain.
incident-bot: PD-84922 auto-resolved (no active incidents).
Matt: handing off to Alex for postmortem, I'll mark as "no customer impact" but note "noisy pages, transient kv warmup".
Alex: will follow up with a short postmortem and update alert threshold/aggregation to reduce flapping. plan: increase eval window to 120s and require sustained violation for 3 datapoints.
Sara: thanks all. quick retrospective action items: (1) short-term: keep 3m suppression during rolling warmups, (2) medium: adjust aggregation + bump p99 threshold by 100ms with tests, (3) long-term: improve KV prefetch heuristics.
Matt: resolved in chat — I'll close PD notes and add links to Grafana and logs in the ticket. :thumbsup:
Alex: taking ticket PD-84921/22 follow-up. will post draft postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow.
Jun: +1, thanks.
Sara: closing thread — ping if it spikes again. :mailbox_with_mail:
